still.en: I still have my old teddy bear from when I was a baby.
still.zh: 我仍然保留着我小时候的旧泰迪熊。

programme.en: My favourite TV programme is about animals in the jungle.
programme.zh: 我最喜欢的电视节目是关于丛林动物的。

lady.en: The kind lady helped me find my lost pencil case.
lady.zh: 那位好心的女士帮我找到了丢失的铅笔盒。

life.en: My grandpa often tells me stories about his life at school.
life.zh: 我爷爷经常给我讲他上学时的生活故事。

different.en: My brother and I have different favourite colours for our bags.
different.zh: 我哥哥和我对我们书包的喜欢颜色不同。

ago.en: We moved to this city two years ago with our parents.
ago.zh: 我们两年前和父母搬到了这个城市。

interviewer.en: The interviewer asked the children about their favourite hobbies.
interviewer.zh: 采访者问孩子们他们最喜欢的爱好是什么。

enough.en: I have enough money to buy a new comic book today.
enough.zh: 我今天有足够的钱买一本新漫画书。

television.en: We watch cartoons on the television every Saturday morning.
television.zh: 我们每周六早上在电视机上看卡通片。

grandchildren.en: My grandmother loves to bake cookies for her grandchildren.
grandchildren.zh: 我的奶奶喜欢为她的孙子孙女们烤饼干。

change.en: The weather can change quickly in spring, so take an umbrella.
change.zh: 春天天气变化很快，所以带把伞。

night.en: Last night I read a funny story before going to bed.
night.zh: 昨晚我在睡觉前读了一个有趣的故事。

work.en: My dad goes to work by bus every morning.
work.zh: 我爸爸每天早上乘公交车去上班。

field.en: The farmer works in the field under the sun.
field.zh: 农民在太阳下的田地里干活。

fire.en: We made a fire to cook hot dogs at the camp.
fire.zh: 我们在营地生火做热狗。

or.en: I don't like apples or oranges for breakfast.
or.zh: 我不喜欢早餐吃苹果或橙子。

radio.en: Grandpa listens to the radio every afternoon.
radio.zh: 爷爷每天下午听收音机。

telephone.en: My mother talks on the telephone with her friend.
telephone.zh: 我妈妈和她的朋友通电话。

couldn't.en: I couldn't ride a bike when I was five.
couldn't.zh: 我五岁时不会骑自行车。

write.en: Please write your name on the paper clearly.
write.zh: 请把你的名字清楚地写在纸上。

hope.en: I hope you can come to my birthday party.
hope.zh: 我希望你能来我的生日派对。

learnt.en: She learnt to swim in the pool last summer.
learnt.zh: 她去年夏天在游泳池学会了游泳。

taught.en: My teacher taught us a new song in class.
taught.zh: 我的老师在课堂上教了我们一首新歌。

language.en: English is a useful language to learn at school.
language.zh: 英语是在学校学习的有用语言。

wrote.en: I wrote a letter to my grandma last night.
wrote.zh: 我昨晚给奶奶写了一封信。

dancer.en: My sister wants to be a famous dancer.
dancer.zh: 我姐姐想成为一名著名的舞蹈演员。

foreign.en: My uncle can speak two foreign languages.

studied.en: Tom studied English for two hours yesterday.
studied.zh: 汤姆昨天学了两个小时英语。

hard.en: She worked hard to finish her homework.

hamburger.en: I ate a hamburger for lunch at school.
hamburger.zh: 我在学校午餐吃了一个汉堡包。

English.en: We had English breakfast at the hotel.
English.zh: 我们在酒店吃了英式早餐。

breakfast.en: I usually have milk and bread for breakfast.
breakfast.zh: 我早餐通常喝牛奶吃面包。

lunch.en: We had rice and chicken for lunch today.
lunch.zh: 我们今天午餐吃了米饭和鸡肉。

sandwich.en: My mom made a sandwich for my picnic.
sandwich.zh: 我妈妈为我的野餐做了一个三明治。

fish and chips.en: Dad cooked fish and chips for dinner.
fish and chips.zh: 爸爸晚餐做了炸鱼加炸薯条。

traditional.en: Dumplings are a traditional Chinese food.
traditional.zh: 饺子是传统的中国食物。

dish.en: My mom cooked a delicious dish for dinner last night.
dish.zh: 我妈妈昨晚做了一道美味的菜肴当晚餐。

very much.en: I like playing football with my friends very much.
very much.zh: 我非常喜欢和朋友们一起踢足球。

gave.en: My dad gave me a new pencil case yesterday.
gave.zh: 我爸爸昨天给了我一个新铅笔盒。

tonight.en: We are going to watch a movie tonight at home.
tonight.zh: 我们今晚要在家里看一部电影。

library.en: There are many storybooks in our school library.
library.zh: 我们学校图书馆里有很多故事书。

student.en: Every student must finish the homework on time.
student.zh: 每个学生都必须按时完成作业。

sent.en: My grandma sent me a birthday card last week.
sent.zh: 我奶奶上周给我寄了一张生日卡片。

CD.en: I bought a new CD of my favorite singer yesterday.
CD.zh: 我昨天买了一张我最喜欢的歌手的新光盘。

idea.en: It is a good idea to plant trees on the farm.
idea.zh: 在农场种树是个好主意。

put.en: Please put your toys back in the box after playing.
put.zh: 玩完后请把你的玩具放回箱子里。

shelf.en: The books are neatly arranged on the shelf in my room.
shelf.zh: 书整齐地摆放在我房间的架子上。

heavy.en: This box is too heavy for me to carry alone.
heavy.zh: 这个箱子太重了，我一个人搬不动。

dictionary.en: I use a dictionary to find new words.

card.en: I wrote a birthday card for my mom.
card.zh: 我给妈妈写了一张生日卡片。

library card.en: I need my library card to borrow books.

ask.en: Can I ask you to play with me?
ask.zh: 我能邀请你和我一起玩吗？

wrong.en: My answer is wrong, so I try again.
wrong.zh: 我的答案是错误的，所以我再试一次。

dear.en: Oh dear! I forgot my homework at home.
dear.zh: 哎呀！我把作业忘在家里了。

information.en: We get information from books and the internet.
information.zh: 我们从书和互联网获取信息。

e-book.en: I read an e-book on my tablet before bed.
e-book.zh: 我睡前在平板上读电子书。

project.en: Our project is about how plants grow.
project.zh: 我们的项目是关于植物如何生长。

guide.en: This guide helps us visit the museum.
guide.zh: 这本指南帮助我们参观博物馆。

film.en: We watched a funny film after school.
film.zh: 我们放学后看了一部有趣的电影。

as well.en: I like playing soccer as well as reading.
as well.zh: 我喜欢踢足球，也喜欢阅读。

way.en: Can you show me a different way to solve this math problem?
way.zh: 你能告诉我解决这道数学题的另一种方法吗？

on.en: I have a book on animals, and it is very interesting.
on.zh: 我有一本关于动物的书，它非常有趣。

topic.en: Our teacher asked us to talk about our favorite topic in class.
topic.zh: 老师让我们在课堂上谈论我们最喜欢的话题。

light.en: This new backpack is light, so I can carry it easily.
light.zh: 这个新背包很轻，所以我可以轻松地背着它。

broken.en: My brother's toy car is broken, and he feels sad.
broken.zh: 我弟弟的玩具车坏了，他很难过。

department store.en: We went to the department store to buy new clothes for school.
department store.zh: 我们去百货商店买上学穿的新衣服。

pocket.en: I put my keys in my jacket pocket before leaving home.
pocket.zh: 出门前我把钥匙放在夹克口袋里。

umbrella.en: Don't forget your umbrella; it might rain this afternoon.
umbrella.zh: 别忘了你的雨伞，今天下午可能会下雨。

sales assistant.en: The sales assistant helped me find the right size shoes.
sales assistant.zh: 售货员帮我找到了合适的鞋码。

wheel.en: The bicycle has one broken wheel, so we need to fix it.
wheel.zh: 这辆自行车有一个轮子坏了，所以我们需要修理它。

easy.en: This puzzle is easy, and I finished it in five minutes.
easy.zh: 这个拼图很容易，我五分钟就完成了。

take.en: I will take the red hat because it matches my coat.
take.zh: 我会选择这顶红帽子，因为它和我的外套很配。

too.en: The soup is too hot, so I cannot eat it now.
too.zh: 汤太烫了，所以我现在不能喝。

try.en: You should try this new game; it is fun.
try.zh: 你应该试试这个新游戏，它很好玩。

lovely.en: My little sister has a lovely smile every morning.
lovely.zh: 我的小妹妹每天早上都有可爱的笑容。

moon.en: We can see the bright moon in the sky tonight.
moon.zh: 今晚我们能看到天空中明亮的月亮。

get.en: Please get some apples from the supermarket for me.
get.zh: 请帮我去超市拿一些苹果。

west.en: The sun sets in the west every evening.
west.zh: 太阳每天傍晚在西方落下。

parent.en: My parent will pick me up after school today.
parent.zh: 今天放学后我的家长会来接我。

stay.en: We will stay at home and watch a movie tonight.
stay.zh: 今晚我们将待在家里看一部电影。

July.en: My birthday is in July, and I love summer then.
July.zh: 我的生日在七月，那时我喜欢夏天。

south.en: Birds fly to the south when winter comes.
south.zh: 冬天来临时鸟儿飞向南方。

remember.en: I always remember to bring my lunch to school.
remember.zh: 我总记得带午餐去学校。

June.en: School ends in June, and we have a long holiday.
June.zh: 学校在六月结束，我们有一个长假。

east.en: The sun rises in the east every morning.
east.zh: 太阳每天早上从东方升起。

best.en: My best friend lives next door to me.
best.zh: 我最好的朋友住在我隔壁。

north.en: We drove north to visit my grandparents.
north.zh: 我们开车向北去看望我的祖父母。

rest.en: After playing for two hours, I need a rest.
rest.zh: 玩了两个小时后，我需要休息。

have a rest.en: Let's have a rest after we finish our homework.
have a rest.zh: 我们做完作业后休息一下吧。

rode.en: My dad rode his bike to work yesterday.
rode.zh: 我爸爸昨天骑自行车去上班。

evening.en: We usually have dinner at seven in the evening.
evening.zh: 我们通常在晚上七点吃晚饭。

late.en: It's getting late, so we must go home now.
late.zh: 天色晚了，所以我们得现在回家。

worker.en: My uncle is a worker in a big factory.
worker.zh: 我叔叔是一家大工厂的工人。

factory.en: The toy factory makes many colorful toys.
factory.zh: 这家玩具工厂生产许多彩色玩具。

early.en: I wake up early to catch the school bus.

taxi.en: We took a taxi to the train station yesterday.
taxi.zh: 我们昨天坐出租车去火车站。

quarter.en: I will meet you in a quarter of an hour.
quarter.zh: 我会在一刻钟后和你见面。

to.en: It is ten to twelve, so lunch is almost ready.
to.zh: 现在是十一点五十分，所以午餐快准备好了。

worry.en: Don't worry about the test; you studied hard.
worry.zh: 别担心考试，你学习很努力。

paper.en: Please write your name on the paper before you start.
paper.zh: 请在开始前在纸上写下你的名字。

Chinese.en: My Chinese friend taught me how to make dumplings.
Chinese.zh: 我的中国朋友教我怎么包饺子。

so.en: The cake was so delicious that I ate two pieces.
so.zh: 蛋糕太好吃了，我吃了两块。

word.en: Can you spell the word 'elephant' for me?
word.zh: 你能帮我拼写“大象”这个词吗？

drew.en: Yesterday I drew a big sun and a happy dog.
drew.zh: 昨天我画了一个大太阳和一只快乐的狗。

cut.en: Mom cut the apple into small pieces for me.
cut.zh: 妈妈把苹果切成小块给我。

piece.en: I found a piece of chocolate in my lunchbox.
piece.zh: 我在午餐盒里找到了一块巧克力。

paint.en: We will paint the fence green this afternoon.
paint.zh: 今天下午我们要把篱笆涂成绿色。

stick.en: He picked up a stick and drew a circle in the sand.
stick.zh: 他捡起一根小木棍，在沙子上画了一个圆圈。

tied.en: I tied my shoelaces before going to school.
tied.zh: 我在上学前系好了鞋带。

string.en: She used a long string to fly the kite.
string.zh: 她用一根长绳子放风筝。

laugh.en: We laugh when we see funny cartoons.
laugh.zh: 我们看到有趣的卡通片时会笑。

wore.en: He wore a red hat to the party yesterday.
wore.zh: 他昨天戴了一顶红帽子去聚会。

letter.en: I wrote a letter to my grandma last week.
letter.zh: 我上周给奶奶写了一封信。

theatre.en: We watched a play at the theatre on Sunday.
theatre.zh: 我们星期天在剧院看了一场戏。

women.en: The women in the park are dancing happily.
women.zh: 公园里的女士们正在快乐地跳舞。

actor.en: The actor told a funny story on the stage.
actor.zh: 那位演员在舞台上讲了一个有趣的故事。

told.en: My dad told me a bedtime story last night.
told.zh: 我爸爸昨晚给我讲了一个睡前故事。

joke.en: My friend told a joke and everyone laughed.
joke.zh: 我的朋友讲了个笑话，大家都笑了。

after.en: After school, I play football with my friends.
after.zh: 放学后，我和朋友们踢足球。

show.en: The magic show was amazing and we clapped.
show.zh: 魔术表演很精彩，我们鼓掌了。

restaurant.en: We had dinner at a new restaurant near our school.
restaurant.zh: 我们在学校附近的一家新饭店吃了晚餐。

ready.en: Are you ready to play basketball with us?
ready.zh: 你准备好和我们一起打篮球了吗？

borrow.en: I want to borrow a storybook from the library.
borrow.zh: 我想从图书馆借一本故事书。

read.en: She read a funny story to her little brother.
read.zh: 她给弟弟读了一个有趣的故事。

at all.en: I don't like eating vegetables at all.
at all.zh: 我一点也不喜欢吃蔬菜。

in.en: We will go to the park in two hours.

another.en: Can I have another piece of cake, please?
another.zh: 请问我能再要一块蛋糕吗？

history.en: Our teacher told us about Chinese history today.
history.zh: 我们老师今天讲了关于中国历史的事情。

question.en: Please raise your hand if you have a question.

forget.en: Don't forget to bring your homework tomorrow.
forget.zh: 别忘了明天带你的作业来。

bring.en: Please bring your pencil case to class every day.
bring.zh: 请每天带你的铅笔盒来上课。

soon.en: The summer holiday will start soon.

when.en: When will you finish your homework?

end.en: The movie will end at eight o'clock.

nervous.en: I feel nervous before the math test.
nervous.zh: 数学考试前我感到紧张。

all right.en: Don't worry, everything will be all right.
all right.zh: 别担心，一切都会没事的。

airport.en: We will meet you at the airport tomorrow.
airport.zh: 我们明天会在机场接你。

ticket.en: I lost my train ticket this morning.
ticket.zh: 我今天早上丢了火车票。

passport.en: Please show your passport at the gate.
passport.zh: 请在门口出示你的护照。

safe.en: The children are safe at school now.
safe.zh: 孩子们现在在学校很安全。

pet.en: My pet cat likes to sleep on the sofa.
pet.zh: 我的宠物猫喜欢睡在沙发上。

speak.en: Can you speak Chinese with your friend?
speak.zh: 你能和你的朋友说中文吗？

building.en: The tall building is our new library.
building.zh: 那栋高楼是我们的新图书馆。

American.en: My uncle is an American teacher in Beijing.
American.zh: 我的叔叔是北京的一位美国老师。

find out.en: I want to find out the truth about the missing cat.
find out.zh: 我想弄清那只失踪的猫的真相。

more.en: Can you tell me more about your school trip?
more.zh: 你能告诉我更多关于你学校旅行的事吗？
